verdict.rationale: Appwrite's own Storage docs cover APIs to upload, download, delete, and list files, plus a preview endpoint that serves transformed images (resize, crop, format conversion), so the upload-and-serve core is delivered. Nothing in the pack documents file-level access rules or CDN-backed delivery for storage; the permissions mention refers to databases and does not transfer. missing for 10: evidence of storage access rules/permissions on files, evidence of CDN-backed delivery, independent or hands-on corroboration.
